project.description: New four-story residential building with six dwelling units. Zoning district RM-5. Standard Plan Review.
project.reviewer: Department of Buildings, first review cycle

comments.heading: Structural
comments.text: The geotechnical report is missing from the submittal. Provide the report prepared by the owner's geotechnical engineer.

comments.heading: Structural
comments.text: A statement of special inspections is not included on the structural notes.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: Per former 13-76, indicate in the code summary whether the building will have an automatic sprinkler system, and the basis for that decision.

comments.heading: Building
comments.text: The dead-end corridor on the typical floor is not dimensioned.

comments.heading: Zoning
comments.text: Landscape and screening information along the parking area is missing from the landscape plan.

comments.heading: General
comments.text: This project has been routed to Standard Plan Review. No action is required.

expected.why: The document already exists with the owner's consultant, so this is a request, not a design task.
The statement of special inspections is prepared by the design professional.
Title 13 was replaced. The sprinkler decision and its basis are a code interpretation for the architect.
Corridors are a means of egress design matter. Don't supply a dimension.
Landscape design belongs to the design team, under the landscaping chapter of zoning.
The letter says no action is required.
